widgets_values: Cinematic shot. The camera starts on a wide shot and performs one slow, continuous dolly-in with a slight upward tilt, then holds on the main character. The character turns toward the light and takes two steps forward. The dog in the foreground lifts its head, then sits. Dust and small leaves drift through the air; background props stay perfectly still. No cuts.

widgets_values_named.value: Wide shot of a closed orange office room with a glowing grid ceiling. The camera performs one slow, slight pan from left to right across the whole shot, then holds. At the start, the empty silver hatchback stands fully visible on the right, facing left; its engine starts and the car rocks slightly, then it reverses smoothly and steadily through the opening in the right wall into the long corridor and disappears into its depth. Meanwhile, the woman in the mustard blouse and teal pleated skirt keeps the yellow handset pressed to her ear, holds the phone base in her hand and walks slowly two or three steps to the right toward the desk. The coiled phone cord stays connected to the desk and computer. A few ceiling panels flicker briefly like a glinch. Shelves, binders, computer, chair and plant remain perfectly still. No dialogue.

nodes.title: ④ + LUMIÈRE · lens flare (EN)
widgets_values: Lighting: warm late-afternoon sunlight rakes in from the left; a cloud passes, the light dims softly then brightens again. When the sun reaches the frame edge, a subtle anamorphic lens flare streaks horizontally. Shallow depth of field, gentle halation on the brightest highlights.

widgets_values_named.value: Soft, even overhead light from the translucent ceiling grid, neutral warm white around 4000K, reflecting on the orange walls and the pale floor. Between the second and the fifth second, three or four individual ceiling panels flicker irregularly, dimming and brightening, while the rest of the ceiling stays steady. The car's white reversing lights switch on as it moves back. No lens flare.

nodes.title: ⑤ + AUDIO · SFX (EN)
widgets_values: Audio: soft wind ambience, distant birdsong, footsteps on gravel synchronized with the two steps, the dog panting then a single short bark, faint rustling leaves. No music, no dialogue.

widgets_values_named.value: Audio: quiet room tone with a faint fluorescent hum. Close small car engine starting with a short starter crank, then the whine of the reverse gear and tires rolling on smooth linoleum, fading into the distant corridor. Slow high-heel footsteps on the hard floor, synchronized with each step of the woman. Soft indistinct female murmuring into the phone. Light electrical clicks synchronized with the flickering panels. No music.

nodes.title: MODE D'EMPLOI
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.3 v3 · Prépa first frame · First/Last · négatifs · éditeur · FX · SFX
Natif ComfyUI + 5 nœuds WAS Node Suite (préinstallé sur Comfy Cloud).

## Flux de travail conseillé
0. **Préparation first frame** (groupe 0, en bas) :
   - ⓪a **Outpaint IA** : une image verticale (ou autre) est réduite dans le cadre cible puis **étendue** par Flux.2 Klein
     (bordures peintes en vert → « remove the green areas »). L'original net est recollé au centre, joint adouci.
   - ⓪b décris le hors-champ si besoin ; ⓪c/⓪d **retouche** globale optionnelle (lumière, ambiance…).
   - Résultat = **FIRST FRAME FINALE**, utilisée partout (vidéo, last frame, inpaint). Aperçu sauvegardé.
1. **① Image source** : n'importe quel format.
2. **⑯ MODE** : `true` = First + Last frame, `false` = first frame seule.
3. **Last frame** (⑮) : **édition IA de la first frame finale** (⑬, décris l'état FINAL) ou image ②.
4. **⑭ Inpaint** : masque peint sur ① (clic droit › *Open in MaskEditor*). Il est recalé automatiquement sur l'image étendue.
   *Itérer vite : mute le groupe GÉNÉRATION (Ctrl+M), ajuste first/last frame, puis réactive.*
5. **Prompts ③④⑤** en anglais, positif + négatif pour chacun.

## Négatifs — à savoir
Le modèle est distillé : à **CFG 1 les négatifs sont ignorés**. ⑥ ON = CFG ⑦ (défaut 2.0).
CFG > 1 = ~2× plus lent. Si l'image « brûle » (contraste, saturation), baisse vers 1.5.

## Format
| Ratio | Paysage 1K | Paysage 2K | Portrait 1K | Portrait 2K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 · 16:9 | 1920×1088 | 2560×1408 | 1088×1920 | 1408×2560 |
| 1 · 4:3 | 1920×1408 | 2560×1920 | 1408×1920 | 1920×2560 |
| 2 · 2.39:1 | 1920×832 | 2560×1088 | 832×1920 | 1088×2560 |

## Limites
- Le mode First+Last est **une seule passe** à pleine résolution (template officiel) : en 2K c'est lourd.
- Klein travaille à ~1 MP : les zones générées sont un peu moins fines que l'original (recollé net au centre).
- Écart first/last trop grand = morphing. Garde le même cadrage, change l'action, pas la scène.





## PROMPTING Process: Use LLM for generate all prompt Set for this WF.

CONTEXT_prompt-set_LTX23_WF-v3.md

Fields you must fill (IDs match the workflow):

|ID	|Field	|Model|

|⓪b	|Off-screen description for outpaint	|Klein|

|⓪d	|First-frame retouch (optional)	|Klein|

|⑬	|Last-frame edit	|Klein|

|③+	|Action / camera / characters / animals	|LTX-2.3|

|④+	|Lighting + lens flare	|LTX-2.3|

|⑤+	|Audio / SFX	|LTX-2.3|

|③− ④− ⑤−	|Negatives for each	|LTX-2.3|



The three positive video fields are concatenated in this order: ③ + ④ + ⑤ → one prompt. Same for the negatives (comma-joined).
